rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I ran backward while an Armu walked...
We had a race to see who was faster.

rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0002
rows.name: The result... I won by default!!

rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0003
rows.name:
The Armus are so attached to me that
they didn't really understand we were
racing.

rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0004
rows.name:
So, as a game, it didn't work
out. I'll have to try and think
up something better for an Armu.

rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0005
rows.name:
A friend of mine does fun experiments,
so I decided to try one experiment
every day too.

rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0006
rows.name:
I mean, it's more fun if you
change things up a bit, right?

rows.label: tlk70000006_01_msg0007
rows.name:
If I don't make it fun, I'll
probably die of boredom looking
after these Armus everyday...
